title: Dataset Curation & Dedup
summary: Dataset Curation & Dedup is a core topic in modern system design. This lesson builds a first-principles model around datasets, features, and quality gates, then connects that model to capacity, failure modes, and operational practice so you can use it in real architectures.

sections.title: What Dataset Curation & Dedup is solving
paragraphs: Dataset Curation & Dedup exists because naive designs around datasets, features, and quality gates break under scale, partial failure, or changing requirements. Before choosing tools, name the problem: which resource is scarce, which invariant must hold, and which user-visible failures are unacceptable.
In interviews and production reviews, strong answers start with constraints (QPS, data size, latency budget, consistency needs) and only then map Dataset Curation & Dedup onto those constraints.

A useful mental model separates the control plane (how you configure and observe Dataset Curation & Dedup) from the data plane (the per-request/per-event path). Confusing the two leads to architectures that look neat and operate poorly.

sections.title: Core mechanics
paragraphs: Mechanically, Dataset Curation & Dedup involves a small set of moving parts: inputs, state, an algorithm or protocol, and outputs/side effects. Draw those parts explicitly. If state is replicated, write down the replication/consistency rule. If work is asynchronous, write down delivery semantics.

Performance characteristics usually come from amplification (how much internal work per external request), locality (whether work stays on one node), and contention (locks, hot keys, leader bottlenecks).

Correctness characteristics usually come from failure handling: retries, timeouts, idempotency, and what clients observe during failover. If you cannot explain the failure story, you do not yet understand Dataset Curation & Dedup.

sections.title: Designing with it
paragraphs: When incorporating Dataset Curation & Dedup into a system, decide the API boundary first: what does a client call, what can fail, and what is retried. Keep the happy path boring and push complexity into well-tested libraries or platform components.

Capacity plan with numbers: estimate peak load, working set, and headroom. Convert that into shard counts, cache sizes, thread/connection pools, or GPU/memory budgets as relevant to Dataset Curation & Dedup.
Prefer reversible rollout: feature flags, dual-running, shadow traffic, and clear dashboards. New uses of Dataset Curation & Dedup should be observable on day one.

sections.title: Operations and failure modes
paragraphs: Operate Dataset Curation & Dedup with SLIs that match user pain (availability, latency, lag, error rate, cost). Alert on burn rates and queue/lag growth, not only host CPU.
Common failures include overload without admission control, retry amplification, silent staleness, schema mismatches, and dependency brownouts. Write a runbook for the top three.
Chaos and game days should include slow dependencies and network delay, not only hard kills. Dataset Curation & Dedup often fails in the gray area.

deepDive.title: Dataset Curation & Dedup — deeper internals
paragraphs: Under the hood, Dataset Curation & Dedup typically exposes knobs for batching, buffering, concurrency, retention, and timeouts. Each knob trades latency, throughput, and cost. Change one at a time and measure.

Instrumentation should include high-signal histograms and exemplars that jump to traces. For data systems, watch amplification and compaction/GC; for RPC systems, watch queue time and saturation; for ML systems, watch memory and tokens/s.
bullets: One knob at a time with a hypothesis

deepDive.title: Dataset Curation & Dedup — integration patterns
paragraphs: Integrate via stable contracts: schemas, idempotency keys, and versioned APIs. Dual-write carefully or prefer CDC/outbox patterns when crossing storage and messaging.
Boundary tests should prove behavior under duplicate delivery, reordering, and clock skew where relevant to Dataset Curation & Dedup.

expert.title: Dataset Curation & Dedup — multi-region and cost
paragraphs: Across regions, RTT and quorum placement dominate. Keep user-critical paths region-local when invariants allow; replicate asynchronously otherwise. Spell out the conflict/staleness model.
Track unit economics for Dataset Curation & Dedup: cost per million requests, per GB stored, or per million tokens. Many scalability projects are cost projects — make the objective explicit.

examples.title: Common review question
examples.description: In design reviews, expect to explain what breaks first when load spikes 10× and how Dataset Curation & Dedup sheds or scales.

keyTakeaways: Dataset Curation & Dedup should be chosen from constraints, not fashion
Mechanics + failure model + capacity math are the core
Operations and contracts decide long-term success
whyItMatters: Without a solid model of Dataset Curation & Dedup, designs either overbuild or fail in production in ways that are hard to debug. This lesson gives a working framework you can reuse across systems involving datasets, features, and quality gates.
